headline: ICTSI sell-off drags PSEi to 6-year low
summary: The PSEi fell 3.12% to close at 5,306.98, its weakest finish in more than six years, as investors sold index heavyweights led by ICTSI.
why: The Philippine Stock Exchange Index is the benchmark for the Philippine stock market. International Container Terminal Services Inc. is a major port operator and one of its largest constituents.
why_moved: Investors sold index heavyweights, led by port operator ICTSI, pushing the benchmark to its weakest close in more than six years.
